newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka rupee closes low on demand for dollars.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka rupee closes low on demand for dollars.

text.p: The Sri Lanka rupee closed low against the dollar in volatile trade, as speculators bought the U.S. unit, dealers said.
The rupee closed at 56.85 to the dollar after falling to a low of 56.70 and rising to 56.92, they said. The currency opened at its previous closing level of 56.80.
The Central Bank set buying and selling prices at 55.9474 and 57.0776, after pushing the dollar up by two cents.
Overnight call money closed at 27 percent after moving between 19 and 23 percent during the day.
Money was kept high by a number of big borrowers entering the market, dealers said.
